notes: kb/Work PB694 (wave 1097 F). Rule (cite.py --check 13.4.5.3 OK, rule 3): 'When no record description entries are specified: a) a RECORD clause shall be specified in the file description entry, b) a FILE phrase specifying file-name-1 and the FROM phrase shall be specified on all WRITE and REWRITE statements associated with the file, and c) an INTO phrase shall be specified on all READ statements associated with the file.' All three sub-rules are now enforced. a) COBOL1836 in DataBinder.MaterializeImpliedRecord (kb/Work PB345), witness negative/pb345-fd-no-record-clause. c) COBOL3983, StatementValidation.CheckReadIntoOnRecordLessFile, asked by SequentialIoBinder.BindRead BEFORE its organization reroute so the relative arm (KeyedIoBinder.BindRead) is under it too; its antecedent is FileModel.HasNoRecordDescriptionEntries (an FD, not a report file or an SD, with no WRITTEN record description entry); witnesses negative/pb694-read-no-into-sequential (sequential arm; its READ INTO line draws nothing) and negative/pb694-read-no-into-relative (relative arm), rejecting at all four editions; the positive pb345_record_less_fd_area (2023 and 85) reads both organizations with INTO and stays clean. b) needs no screen of its own because none is reachable: the record-name-1 alternative of WRITE / REWRITE names 'a logical record in the file section of the data division' (cite.py --check 14.9.51.3 OK rule 5; 14.9.35.3 OK rule 1), which a record-less entry does not have (its implied record has no record-name), so no WRITE / REWRITE without the FILE phrase can be associated with such a file; the FILE file-name-1 alternative is Annex A.4.13, claimed from 2002 (kb/Work PB5579), and is the one form of WRITE and REWRITE that binds: pb5579_write_file_sequential and pb5579_rewrite_file write and rewrite a file with no record description entries (RECORD CONTAINS 10) and read it back with INTO. Editions: the record-less FD and this rule are edition-invariant here (the 85 golden pins it). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.cs#MaterializeImpliedRecord (kb/Work PB2296 M7 moved the member from DataBinder to FileControlBinder (the file binder); the same rule is asked by the same code) retired-witness: conformance:cases/13.4.5-File-description/a413-rewrite-file-declined (the FILE phrase is no longer declined (COBOL1706 and DeclinedFilePhrase are retired); the a413 fixtures are deleted) retired-witness: conformance:cases/13.4.5-File-description/a413-write-file-format-1 (the FILE phrase is no longer declined (COBOL1706 and DeclinedFilePhrase are retired); the a413 fixtures are deleted) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/SequentialIoBinder.cs#DeclinedFilePhrase (the FILE phrase is no longer declined (COBOL1706 and DeclinedFilePhrase are retired); the a413 fixtures are deleted)
